mechanism.claim: The next eight-hour direction after a volatile BTC block is conditional on analog recurrence of the completed block's half-hour directional path and within-block variation allocation. A fixed nearest-analog estimator can represent nonlinear path states without OOS adaptation.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the frozen nearest-analog prediction
mechanism.why_distinct: HVPAR is a nonparametric path-recurrence model over 32 ordered half-hour coordinates and one causal volatility rank. HVITR was one linear ridge over aggregate topology statistics; prior handcrafted candidates used individual topology gates. HVPAR reuses no event set, prediction, threshold, control, or OOS outcome and uses no flow, funding, OI, basis, calendar, or cross-asset input.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: both reference analogs and OOS queries require causal eight-hour variation rank at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: fixed-boundary high-dimensional price-path recurrence is absent from Gross9

training_contract.label: log(exit_open/entry_open), entry=D+5m, exit=entry+8 elapsed hours
training_contract.training_rows: all source-valid decisions with finite ordered features and complete label
training_contract.standardization: population mean/std on all training rows only; reject nonfinite or zero scale

estimator.distance: Euclidean distance over all 33 standardized ordered features
estimator.prediction: weighted arithmetic mean of neighbor labels
estimator.training_prediction: leave current reference row out before selecting its 64 neighbors

training_contract.prediction_strength_threshold: strict empirical 0.75 quantile of absolute leave-one-out predictions over every reference row

feature_contract.block: 480 exact coherent BTCUSDT bars_binance interval=1m rows [D-8h,D)
feature_contract.path_levels: 17 levels: first bar open followed by closes at minute offsets 29,59,...,479; the 16 log differences are divided by sqrt(full close-to-close squared-return sum)
feature_contract.variation_shares: each close-to-close squared return is assigned to the segment containing its later close; the first segment therefore has 29 returns and each later segment has 30; each segment sum is divided by the full 479-return squared sum
feature_contract.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded

oos_clock.eligibility: source valid, variation_rank>=0.65, frozen prediction finite/nonzero, and absolute prediction >= frozen leave-one-out training q75
oos_clock.reservation: fixed boundaries are naturally half-open; exit first on equal open
oos_clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.oos_execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: single nonlinear path-analog mechanism specified independently after terminating HVITR unchanged

stopping_rule: Freeze preregistration, analog model, OOS source support, Gross9 novelty, then strict economics; terminal first failure with no feature, neighbor count, distance, weight, threshold, side, hold, clock, subset, or control repair.
